packageName: Relay Garage Door (Zooz ZEN16 + Tilt/Contact Sensor)
author: Heatvent
releaseNotes:
v1.3.0 - Chime volume for the garage sounds (door warning and low battery reminder), separate from the chime's own volume. Needs a chime driver whose playSound takes a volume, such as Zooz ZSE50 2.3.0.
v1.2.1 - Low battery reminder can also repeat every 5, 15 or 30 minutes.
v1.2.0 - Low battery reminder: notification when the sensor battery drops below a level, then a short chime (or buzzer chirp) every few hours within set hours; never while the door moves.
v1.1.0 - Door sensor can be a tilt sensor, a wireless contact sensor, or a wired contact (ZEN16/ZEN17 input reporting as a contact or a switch); optional fully-open sensor for exact open/closing states; warning buzzer relay or chime before and while the door moves; no-battery device for wired sensors; a command during the warning cancels it.
v1.0.0 - Initial release: one garage door device from a relay (Zooz ZEN16) and a tilt/contact sensor (Zooz ZSE43), with opening/closing states, manual-operation tracking, battery, failure notifications, and a clean Home Assistant cover via Maker API.
